title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: No official or media item on infant RSV antibodies this week; the signal is social. Two high-engagement posts from pregnant women ask whether to get a maternal RSV vaccine or pay for an infant long-acting antibody after birth, and whether paying for both is worth it. Another couple says they will delay RSV vaccination after side-effect worries. RSV volume fell from 29 to 15.
products.implication: Parents frame the infant-antibody decision around out-of-pocket cost and maternal-versus-infant choice, with peers rather than clinicians as the visible information source. No brand is named, but the self-pay cost question is the live issue.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence pack on maternal and infant RSV immunisation strategies for obstetric and paediatric societies to inform their own patient guidance. Map policy discussions on infant RSV protection with Taiwan CDC advisers. Keep monitoring parent forums for cost and access questions; no consumer-facing messaging.
products.signal_zh: 本週無嬰兒RSV抗體相關官方或媒體訊息，訊號來自社群。兩則孕婦高互動貼文詢問應接種孕婦RSV疫苗，或於產後自費為嬰兒施打長效抗體，以及兩者皆自費是否值得。另一對夫妻表示因擔心副作用將延後RSV接種。RSV聲量由29降至15。
products.implication_zh: 家長以自費成本及孕婦與嬰兒擇一的角度看待嬰兒抗體決策，可見的資訊來源為同儕而非醫師。未點名品牌，但自費成本是目前焦點議題。
products.action_zh: 為婦產科及兒科醫學會準備中立的孕婦與嬰兒RSV免疫策略實證資料包，供其制定病人衛教指引。與疾管署諮詢委員梳理嬰兒RSV保護的政策討論。持續監測家長論壇的費用及可近性問題；不進行消費者端訊息溝通。
who_zh: 疾管署預防接種諮詢委員
接生醫院及新生兒病房

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.signal: High-dose flu vaccines appear mainly in pharmacist explainers comparing four flu vaccine types and in national uptake reports (CNA, 中天) noting high-dose vaccines. ETtoday's stock-below-half report also covers adjuvanted, high-dose and self-paid options. Taipei's mayor directed stronger promotion of enhanced flu vaccines. High-dose volume was 14 versus 12; enhanced-type-not-stated mentions fell from 36 to 11.
products.implication: With overall flu stock reported below half and the 50+ stage due on November 2, questions about whether enhanced doses remain available to the 65+ priority group, and in the self-pay market, are likely. Pharmacist comparison content sits close to product-claim territory.
products.action: Brief pharmacist associations and local health bureaus with label-accurate facts (licensed age, programme eligibility) so explainers stay accurate. Prepare a supply and allocation Q&A on enhanced doses with Taiwan CDC. Engage Taipei's health department on how it plans to carry out the mayor's enhanced-vaccine directive.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達）· 核准65歲以上
products.signal_zh: 高劑量流感疫苗主要見於比較四種流感疫苗類型的藥師衛教文，以及提及高劑量疫苗的全國接種報導（中央社、中天）。ETtoday的庫存不到一半報導亦涵蓋佐劑型、高劑量及自費選項。台北市長指示加強推廣加強型流感疫苗。高劑量聲量為14 vs 12；未註明類型的加強型提及數由36降至11。
products.implication_zh: 在整體流感庫存傳不到一半、50歲以上階段將於11月2日開打之際，65歲以上優先族群及自費市場是否仍有加強型疫苗，可能引發詢問。藥師比較內容接近產品宣稱的範疇。
products.action_zh: 向藥師公會及地方衛生局提供符合仿單的資訊（核准年齡、計畫資格），確保衛教內容正確。與疾管署準備加強型疫苗供應與分配Q&A。與台北市衛生局溝通其如何落實市長的加強型疫苗指示。

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week: Tdap volume was 3 versus 7, with no official or media item. Posts include a pregnant user describing contractions and an ER visit after a pertussis shot (the doctor said it was unrelated), another reporting fever and headache, and a pregnant woman asking peers whether Tdap is necessary.
products.implication: The signal is thin but concentrated in pregnancy, where single anecdotes can shape peers' decisions alongside RSV and flu choices.
products.action: Keep monitoring. Have a maternal Tdap safety evidence summary ready for obstetric societies, and confirm adverse-event reporting pathways are clear to prescribers. No proactive public outreach is warranted on this signal.
products.sub_zh: 百日咳 · 孕婦及成人追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週訊息少：Tdap聲量為3 vs 7，無官方或媒體訊息。貼文包括一名孕婦描述接種百日咳疫苗後宮縮並至急診（醫師表示無關）、另一人反映發燒頭痛，以及一名孕婦詢問同儕是否有必要接種Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 訊號微弱但集中於孕期，單一經驗分享可能與RSV及流感選擇一併影響同儕決策。
products.action_zh: 持續監測。為婦產科醫學會備妥孕婦Tdap安全性實證摘要，並確認處方者清楚不良事件通報管道。此訊號無須主動對外溝通。
who_zh: 食藥署藥物安全監視窗口

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added the Novavax public COVID-19 vaccine from October 19 and said it plans additional Novavax doses. Its October 20 holiday notice lists Novavax as an option. Kaohsiung coverage mentions Novavax in the expansion to adults 50+ from November 2. Threads safety claims this week target COVID-19 vaccines in general; none name Novavax.
products.implication: The November 2 expansion to 50+ is the next test of site-level availability for Novavax and of delivery timing for the additional doses CDC announced. Generic COVID-19 safety misinformation could spill onto any brand.
products.action: Align with Taiwan CDC on the delivery schedule for additional Novavax doses, and with local health bureaus on which sites stock it ahead of November 2. Prepare a factual HCP-facing Q&A on the protein-based platform and the label. Keep safety-signal monitoring and a holding statement ready.
who: Local health bureaus (Kaohsiung, Nantou and others)
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質疫苗 · 由Sanofi經銷
products.signal_zh: 疾管署10月19日起新增Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗，並表示規劃追加Novavax劑量。10月20日連假公告列出Novavax為選項。高雄報導提及11月2日起擴大至50歲以上成人時包括Novavax。本週Threads安全性說法針對整體COVID-19疫苗，均未點名Novavax。
products.implication_zh: 11月2日擴大至50歲以上，將是Novavax接種點供應及疾管署宣布追加劑量到貨時程的下一個考驗。一般性COVID-19安全錯誤訊息可能外溢至任何品牌。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署確認追加Novavax劑量的到貨時程，並與地方衛生局確認11月2日前哪些接種點備有該疫苗。準備以醫事人員為對象、關於蛋白質平台及仿單的事實型Q&A。持續安全訊號監測並備妥因應聲明。
who_zh: 地方衛生局（高雄、南投等）

issues.title: Second-stage expansion to adults 50+ meets thinning flu stock
issues.note: With stock reported below half after about 3.76 million shots, expect local reports of product-specific shortages, including enhanced doses and COVID-19 brand availability at sites.
issues.title_zh: 第二階段擴大至50歲以上成人，適逢流感疫苗庫存吃緊
issues.note_zh: 在接種約376萬劑後庫存傳不到一半，預期地方將出現特定產品短缺報導，包括加強型疫苗及接種點COVID-19品牌供應。

issues.title: Active flu season as public antiviral extension runs to November 15
issues.note: CDC says flu is still in its epidemic period and Matsu reports a cluster of nearly 100 cases; another extension or severity update would renew pressure on vaccine supply and late-season demand.
issues.title_zh: 流感季活躍，公費抗病毒藥劑延長至11月15日
issues.note_zh: 疾管署表示流感仍處流行期，馬祖通報近100例群聚；若再度延長或更新嚴重度，將再次加重疫苗供應及季末需求壓力。

issues.title: COVID-19 and mRNA rumours spill over to other vaccines
issues.note: The Pentagon-ban rumour and Threads claims on long COVID, black box warnings and approval ties show how fast generic claims spread; keep holding lines and an HCP evidence pack ready.
issues.title_zh: COVID-19及mRNA謠言外溢至其他疫苗
issues.note_zh: 國防部禁用謠言及Threads上關於長COVID-19、黑框警語與核准關係的說法，顯示一般性說法擴散快速；持續備妥因應口徑及醫事人員實證資料包。

self_pay.title: Self-pay flu appears in explainers, but without prices or stock data
self_pay.note: Explainers and pharmacist comparisons mention self-paid options alongside adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines. No item reports clinic prices, self-pay stock levels or clinic promotion.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費流感疫苗見於衛教文，但無價格或庫存資料
self_pay.note_zh: 衛教文及藥師比較提及自費選項以及佐劑型、高劑量疫苗。無任何報導提及診所價格、自費庫存或診所促銷。

self_pay.title: Donated doses target people outside eligibility in Nantou
self_pay.note: A company donated 400 flu doses that Nantou will give free to non-subsidised groups from November 2. This points to demand from people outside the public programme, met here by charity rather than clinic sales.
self_pay.title_zh: 南投捐贈疫苗鎖定不符資格民眾
self_pay.note_zh: 一家企業捐贈400劑流感疫苗，南投將自11月2日起免費提供給非公費對象。顯示公費計畫以外民眾有需求，此處由捐贈而非診所銷售滿足。

self_pay.title: Infant RSV antibody cost weighs on expectant parents
self_pay.note: Posts from pregnant women ask whether paying for an infant long-acting antibody is worth it versus maternal vaccination; no prices are cited. There is nothing this week on Tdap self-pay pricing or stock.
self_pay.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV抗體費用成準父母負擔
self_pay.note_zh: 孕婦貼文詢問自費嬰兒長效抗體相較孕婦接種是否值得；未提及價格。本週無Tdap自費價格或庫存相關訊息。

self_pay.title: Outbreak and cost-of-illness stories reference self-pay
self_pay.note: Coverage of the Matsu flu cluster and of the unvaccinated grandmother's ICU bill mentions self-paid vaccination, keeping private access in view for people not eligible for public doses.
self_pay.title_zh: 疫情及疾病成本報導提及自費
self_pay.note_zh: 馬祖流感群聚及未接種阿嬤加護病房帳單的報導提及自費接種，使不符公費資格者持續關注自費管道。
